description: Buyer Mandate (AP2 Intent Mandate): what the buyer organisation lets its agent do. Signed by the buyer with a detached JWS in `signature` over the canonical JSON of all other fields.

auto_order_limit_eur.description: Orders up to this total (excl. VAT) may be placed without a human.
auto_order_limit_eur.title: Auto Order Limit Eur

hard_limit_eur.description: Orders above this are refused even with approval.
hard_limit_eur.title: Hard Limit Eur

excluded_allergens.description: GS1 codes or names, e.g. 'AM' or 'milk'. Hard rule.
excluded_allergens.title: Excluded Allergens

exclude_may_contain.description: Also refuse 'may contain' traces of excluded allergens.
exclude_may_contain.title: Exclude May Contain

required_claims.description: e.g. FREE_FROM_LACTOSE; missing claim needs approval.
required_claims.title: Required Claims

substitution_policy.description: official_auto: Valio's own substitution list may be used without a human if every other rule passes.
substitution_policy.title: Substitution Policy

max_substitute_price_increase_pct.description: A line that replaces another product (substitute, or a second product topping up a partial stock) may cost at most this many % more per kg / litre (per sales unit if neither has a comparison unit) than the original, else a human approves, whatever substitution_policy says. The original's price comes from Valio (a signed offer or the gateway's own quote), never from the agent. None: no check.
max_substitute_price_increase_pct.title: Max Substitute Price Increase Pct

autonomy_mode.description: advise: the agent may only recommend (place_order returns a proposal); confirm_cart: every cart waits for the buyer's signed confirmation; autonomous: the agent orders on its own within the guardrails. Capped by the Agent Passport.
autonomy_mode.title: Autonomy Mode

title: Mandate
